officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 4. Kåsjön - Jonsered
keyFacts: Canonical current official name is Kåsjön - Jonsered.
Official distance is 8 km / 8000 m.
Official estimated time is 3 h.
Official difficulty is blue / medium.
Stage runs from Lake Kåsjön to Jonsered in Partille municipality.

Route goes northeast toward Lake Madern, passes a shelter at Madern, separates from Vildmarksleden at Madern, passes a small tarn/picnic place near Råhult, continues through older woodland, crosses E20 and descends into Jonsered.
Official access notes identify Åstebo for Kåsjön access and Jonsered station for Jonsered access.
WST status/API check found no stage-specific closure, deviation or reroute on 2026-04-29.

huntingAndForestry.summary: Partille conducts wildlife management/hunting on municipal land, mainly roe deer and moose. Moose hunting in southern Sweden runs from the second Monday in October through 28/29 February. Keep dogs controlled, wear visibility in hunting season and obey temporary signs.
caveats: Exact hunting-area overlap and live hunt dates require local/current check.

Some reports mention poor marking or losing Bohusleden after about 7 km; this is a caution in the Jonsered approach/overlapping-route area rather than a confirmed current reroute.
